scoring_justification: Full Monte Carlo simulation cannot be re-run in the verifier. The checker directly compares the agent's computed yields, peak energies, and time-resolved fractions to the paper-reported values with appropriate tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold total yields, binary peak energies, and structural criteria for time-resolved emission
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper-reported values (Sparrow et al 1992) and reference solver output (solve.sh)
hidden_assets.generation_method: Direct extraction from the paper's text and the reference oracle's hardcoded solution; cross-checked for consistency.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: The values are verbatim from the paper and the oracle solution, not invented.

outputs.description: Total electron yields per incident ion for foil thicknesses 1, 10, 20, 44, 100, 1000 µg/cm², with forward/backward breakdown.
Absolute doubly-differential electron yield for the 44 µg/cm² foil, binned in energy and angle.
Energies of the double binary peaks at 40° for the 44 µg/cm² foil.
Cumulative forward/backward emission percentages as a function of projectile position for 1, 10, 100 µg/cm² foils.

output_contract.notes: All scored outputs are derived from the full Monte Carlo simulation. The checker compares total yields, doubly-differential yields, binary peak energies, and time-resolved fractions against reference values from the paper, with appropriate tolerances.

steps.description: Compare total, forward, backward yields to paper gold with relative tolerance 15% and check monotonic trend.
Verify energy-angle table shape and presence of binary peak signal at 40° around 4.5 and 7.6 keV.
Check that the reported double binary peak energies match 4500 and 7600 eV within ±500 eV.
Structural checks on cumulative emission fractions: monotonic, correct endpoints, and approximate paper-reported fractions at exit.
